name: The Broken Oath
about: Two houses tied together by a royal marriage turn on each other when the bride dies. Every house has to pick a side, and whoever wins may not stop at the other's walls.
title: The Broken Oath of {groom.houseName} and {kin.houseName}

beats.speaker: kin
text: The bride {kin} sent to {hall} to seal the peace with {groom.house} is found dead at the bottom of the tower stairs. {kin} doesn't believe she fell.
{kin}'s daughter, married into {groom.house} with the King's own blessing, dies giving birth at {hall}. {kin.house} says the midwives were {groom}'s people.

memory.kin: My child died at {hall}, in {groom}'s keeping.
memory.groom: {kin} calls my house murderers over my own wife's grave.

court.text: {kin} of {kin.house} stands before the throne in mourning black: "The crown married my child to {groom.house}, Your Grace. Now my child is dead. What will the crown do?"

options.label: Send the King's justice to {hall} to find the truth
options.result: The King's justice rides to {hall}. Both houses wait to hear what he finds, and for now they only wait.

options.label: Blame {groom}
options.result: The King names {groom} as the one to blame. In {hall}, {groom} smashes a cup against the wall.

options.label: Pay for prayers and drop the matter (150 gold)
options.result: Prayers are sung for the dead bride in every church. {kin} hears them, but it doesn't help.

beats.speaker: kin
beats.text: Men without banners burn {groom.house}'s farms from {home} to the river. Everyone knows whose men they are.

court.text: {envoy} of {envoy.house}: "{kin.house} is raiding {groom.house}'s lands, Your Grace, and {groom} is calling up his banners. Stop it now, or pick a side."

options.label: Order a truce between them (150 gold)
options.hint: both −5 · two years of peace, if they keep it
options.result: The King proclaims peace between {groom.house} and {kin.house}. Neither lord smiles.

options.label: Side with {groom.house}
options.result: The crown sides with {groom.house}. In {home}, {kin} swears the crown will learn what that costs.

options.label: Side with {kin.house}
options.result: The crown sides with {kin.house}. {groom} stops sending ravens to Kingsmere.

beats.speaker: groom
beats.text: {groom.house} and {kin.house} are at open war. Their armies meet in the fields below {home}, and the realm counts the dead.

beats.speaker: groom
beats.text: {groom.house} wins the battle. {groom} looks from the smoke of {home} toward Kingsmere, and asks why a crown that couldn't keep the peace should keep the throne.

court.text: {envoy}: "{groom} has won, Your Grace, and now he likes winning. Tie him to you now, or fight him."

options.label: Give {groom} land and titles (400 gold)
options.result: {groom} is made Warden of the borderlands. {groom.He} kneels, and stays loyal.

options.label: Remind {groom} who is King
options.result: The King's letter to {groom} is short. {groom.His} answer is shorter.

beats.speaker: kin
beats.text: {kin.house} takes the field, and {kin} rides into {hall} through its broken gate. Grief has turned into an army, and armies want more.

court.text: {envoy}: "{kin} has avenged the bride, Your Grace, but isn't finished. Pay {kin.him} off, or fight {kin.him}."

options.label: Give {kin} {hall} by royal decree (400 gold)
options.result: By the King's word, {hall} belongs to {kin.house}. {kin} kneels in the ruins of {groom}'s hall.

options.label: Order {kin} home
options.result: The King orders {kin} home. {kin} reads the order out to {kin.his} captains, and they laugh.

beats.speaker: groom
beats.text: {groom} turns the winning army toward Kingsmere. The crown wouldn't pick a side, so now it's the next target.

beats.speaker: kin
beats.text: {kin} marches on Kingsmere, saying the crown that married off {kin.his} child owes {kin.him} for it.

beats.speaker: envoy
beats.text: {groom} and {kin} meet at the bride's grave with the King's justice between them. Nobody forgives, but nobody draws a sword.

beats.speaker: envoy
beats.text: Bought off with titles, the winner keeps the peace the crown couldn't. {thread} ends with one great house stronger than before.

beats.speaker: envoy
beats.text: The army that came for Kingsmere is broken at its walls. {thread} ends where it started: with a grave and a grudge.
With one of the two lords dead, nobody is left to carry on {thread}.
